versions.changelog:
Initial release of the Zhengzhou Keweilai stepper motor controller debugging assistant.

- Provides full support for generating Markdown format technical documents.
- Supports automatic generation of MicroPython demo code (ESP32/Pico) and PC Python demo code (pymodbus).
- Allows reading and writing of all register addresses.
- Includes detailed device specs, register mapping, and standard operation processes.
- Offers clear step-by-step procedures for device initialization and basic operation.
- Contact and technical support information included.
